program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (2.4e-6, 1.5e-6, 3.5e-6),
    "gmidl": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),
    "Ll":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid7": (15.0, 10.0, 16.0),
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I7":    (6.0e-6, 4e-6, 7.5e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (1.7e-12, 1.0e-12, 4e-12),
    "kz":    (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    gmidn = 9.0
    Ln = p["Ln"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.1)

    # reference diode; solve its actual VGS (width may be clamped)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, iref, vds=0.6)
    Wref = max(mref.W, 0.42)
    lo, hi = 0.2, 1.4
    for _ in range(50):
        v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op("n", Wref, Ln, v, v)["Id"] > iref:
            hi = v
        else:
            lo = v
    vgsr = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    # size mirrors at their real Vds so currents are exact
    i5u = lut.op("n", Wref, Ln, vgsr, vtail)["Id"]
    W5 = Wref * It / i5u
    vout0 = 0.9
    i8u = lut.op("n", Wref, Ln, vgsr, vout0)["Id"]
    W8 = Wref * I7 / i8u
    o8 = lut.op("n", W8, Ln, vgsr, vout0)

    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidl"], p["Ll"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wref, Ln)
    n.M("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, Ln)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W8, Ln)
    # vinp up -> n1 down -> M7 more current -> vout up (non-inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + o8["gds"])
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = 0.95 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    dz = Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * dz) if dz > 0 else -1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(dz) + 1e-30)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
